title_patterns_that_work: Using parentheses for parenthetical hooks like '(Data Breakdown)', '(The Truth)', and '(I Checked The Data)'
Adding '#Shorts' to titles as short-form content consistently drives higher view counts (e.g., StubHub, Cashify, Sweatcoin)
Direct investigation questions starting with 'Is [Brand] Legit...' or 'Does [Brand] Actually Pay...'
title_patterns_to_avoid: Vague or purely descriptive titles without high-intent keywords like 'Legit', 'Scam', or 'Trust'
Long-form formats currently underperforming compared to high-engagement short-form investigative hooks
notes: Short-form videos (indicated by #Shorts) significantly outperform long-form content in terms of view velocity, particularly when investigating popular apps, ticket platforms, and e-commerce services for legitimacy or payouts.
